front.title: Scientific Data Admissibility Records: A Fail-Closed Layered Model for Research Artifacts

abstract.t: Automated research pipelines routinely move scientific data and derived claims from ingestion to publication without a machine- checkable record of what has actually been verified. This document defines a Scientific Data Admissibility Record (SDAR): a small, serializable structure that keeps schema conformance, provenance, numerical verification, empirical evidence, and interpretation as separate layers, each with an explicit status. It specifies a fail- closed aggregation rule so that an unverified or not-yet-run layer can never be silently promoted into an accepted result. The document also defines an XML serialization and processing rules, and is intended as a starting point for discussion rather than a proposed standard.
